name: 19th Workshop on Labour Economics (IAAEU, Trier)
organizer: IAAEU and Chair of Personnel Economics, Trier University
venue: IAAEU, Trier University Campus II, Behringstraße 21, Building H, 7th floor
submission_requirements: Extended abstracts or full papers (preferred), electronically via the online form or by email to wle@iaaeu.de; full papers due 1 March 2027 if accepted; presentation slots up to 35 minutes; PhD students particularly encouraged; state interest when submitting to be considered for special sessions on counterfactual impact evaluation (with the European Commission JRC CC-ME)
registration_fee: EUR 150 for all participants (covers lunches, social event and conference dinner)
keynotes: Bas van der Klaauw (Tinbergen Institute / Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam)
